follow-on: the gate writes the HTML and JSON at :954-955 and asserts only the serialized byte size at :953, so dropping one of the tables the done_when requires from render() would leave the gate exiting 0; assert the rendered tables and the improvement count against independent expected content, the same shape the srtj-evidence-supply review recorded at srtj-evidence-supply-run.py:476.

follow-on: the third ranked improvement hardcodes "The name gold has 194 human source/target pairs", while the report's own paired_edits measures 83 + 104 = 187 scored pairs; 194 is the raw human_edit_source row count (108 calibration + 86 validation), so the headline number in the recommendation disagrees with the measurement printed beside it unless the two counts are distinguished.

follow-on: the artifact stem derived at :22 begins "srtj", an abbreviation of the plan name sn-review-through-jev, which the repository naming rule bans in filenames; the path is fixed by brief.md:44-46 so the defect is the assignment, and the whole fragment directory already carries the same pattern.
